Coimbatore Hospitals Remove Hindi From Medicine Covers After DMK Criticism

Coimbatore and Karur hospitals have removed Hindi from medicine covers following criticism from DMK leader TRB Raaja. The covers, which featured Hindi text, were reportedly introduced during the previous DMK regime. Health Minister KG Arunraj stated that the covers in question were implemented during the prior DMK administration.
